title: Constrained payment route planning, counterfactuals and opportunity search
source: GitHub Issue #6; frozen architecture lock + existing route-compiler, capability, Lab, opportunities, agents, economic and protocol packages
policy: Register only. No P16 implementation or acceptance is claimed by the graph. The routine skill is procedural guidance; the typed deterministic planner remains the only route/scenario computation path and has zero authority to commit financial effects.

work_orders.lane_scope: Source-backed gap matrix, routine/skill loader architecture decision, typed trigger contract, deterministic routine manifest/state-machine and file-disjoint integration agreement; reconcile P15/current-state drift.
work_orders.acceptance: Gap matrix names exact existing source APIs and missing seams; ADR/decision preserves frozen architecture; routine/skill version pin and typed trigger behavior specified; dependencies and owners confirmed.

work_orders.lane_scope: Independent sender/recipient eligible-rail snapshots, evidence/freshness/exclusion contracts, compose existing route-compiler and exact-ranking APIs. Own route-discovery contracts and integration adapters only; no Lab core, opportunity core or UX files.
work_orders.acceptance: Real connected instances/observations only; independent sender+receiver evidence; every route-shape exclusion stated; hard gates before scoring; exact deterministic metrics/ranking and search-budget disclosure tested.

work_orders.lane_scope: Routine scenario catalog + Lab-based replay/counterfactual composition and protocol netting/delay/credit/group-payment semantics. Do not change route discovery files, opportunity core or UI files.
work_orders.acceptance: Each required counterfactual varies named assumptions over identical base facts; deterministic bounded deltas; gross-obligation history/currency/deadline/backing/consent invariants tested; simulations have no production authority.

work_orders.lane_scope: Evidence-backed opportunity/matching proposal model, privacy/minimum-disclosure and consent/expiry/decline/revoke lifecycle, durable WAITING_FOR_OPPORTUNITIES criteria/events. Do not edit route-compiler, Lab core or UI.
work_orders.acceptance: Only evidence-backed opportunities become offers; private party/payment data not disclosed without consent; wait mission resumes/cancels/expires safely; matches never dispatch without fresh preview and explicit scoped approval.

work_orders.lane_scope: Integrate typed intent trigger + skill loader + versioned routine manifest and durable mission state machine; expose ranked routes/counterfactuals/proceed-or-wait UX; reconcile maps and deliver end-to-end acceptance.
work_orders.acceptance: Validated typed payment intent triggers exactly one pinned routine; routine/skill load failure fails closed; real evidence-backed routes and exclusions render distinctly from conditional options; proceed/wait tasks persist/resume; no effect without existing authority and explicit approval; exact-commit E2E and evidence tiers published.

closure_policy: Lanes A/B/C are file-disjoint per ADR-0009 D3 and run concurrently; workers do not commit. The TL verifies each lane (battery + tsc --noEmit), commits per lane, and pushes at acceptance (ADR-0009 D7). P16-D integrates and closes the wave; no implementation or acceptance is claimed by this graph beyond recorded statuses.
